claim.claimant_statement: I locked the car and left the laptop in the boot while I ate dinner. When I came back the boot lock was broken and the laptop was gone.

witness.statement: I saw something on the back seat of the car when I walked past around 8 pm.

evidence.boot_lock_photo: photo of a damaged boot lock, no timestamp
evidence.cctv: restaurant says footage is overwritten after 3 days

policy.clause_summary: See unattended-vehicle clause; the full text has not been attached to this file.

constraints.statement: Follow the unattended-vehicle clause exactly as stated in the reference facts.
Treat the lack of a receipt alone as a reason to refuse.
Prefer asking for missing evidence over refusing outright.

reference_facts.name: unattended_vehicle_clause
reference_facts.value: Items visible inside an unattended vehicle are excluded; items in a locked boot are covered if forced entry is shown.

reference_facts.name: police_report_deadline_days
reference_facts.value: Report must be filed within 3 days of the loss

criteria.approve: The police report is dated and detailed enough to support the claim.
criteria.deny: The police report lacks the dates or details needed to support the claim.

claim_status.instructions: Choose the status decision for this claim.

criteria.accept_and_pay: Accept the claim and pay the amount less the excess.
criteria.accept_partial: Pay part of the claim, such as a capped amount.
criteria.request_missing_evidence: Ask the claimant for specific missing documents.
criteria.refer_to_investigator: Pass the claim to a fraud investigator.
criteria.refer_to_legal_review: Ask the legal team to interpret the policy clause.
criteria.decline_under_exclusion: Decline the claim under the unattended-vehicle exclusion.
criteria.decline_for_late_report: Decline because the police report was filed late.

evidence_reliability.instructions: Rate how reliable the evidence in the file is overall.
